objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (18 November 2026) on NAE-METRIC-20261118-001's direction 2: which double meetings (two knots sharing two distinctions) are harmless for not-all-equal bond distance, the weave's against lone pairs, since the weave is the base the owner's premise is most tested on. Found while designing: in patches of the weave the double meetings are never the cause; every pair held by a bond is steps apart plus one, and the only pairs no bond holds are pairs of distinctions each in a single knot, of opposite classes and facing each other (a lone double meeting is the smallest case). Serves G1 and G16; tests A97 and A39; B200.
stop_rule: One frozen computation with its read-out; proof; referee hand-off; report.
title: Which double meetings are harmless
